description: Source code for validating limitations in shader code, specifically traversing and analyzing shader intermediate tree to enforce GLSL 1.0 constraints, including loop and index validation.

classes.name: ValidateConstIndexExpr
classes.description: Traverser to validate if an expression is a constant index expression, including loop indices.

classes.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser
classes.description: Traverser that enforces GLSL 1.0 limitations on shader code, including loop and index validation.

methods.name: GetLoopSymbolId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique symbol ID for a loop's index variable.

methods.name: ValidateConstIndexExpr::isValid
methods.description: Checks if the traversed node represents a valid constant index expression.

methods.name: ValidateConstIndexExpr::visitSymbol
methods.description: Visits a symbol node to determine if it is a valid loop index or constant.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::visitSymbol
methods.description: Checks if a symbol is a loop index and if it is assigned within the loop body.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::visitBinary
methods.description: Checks binary operations, particularly index operations, for validation.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::visitLoop
methods.description: Validates loop type and header, and traverses loop body.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::isLoopIndex
methods.description: Determines if a symbol is a loop index based on stored symbol IDs.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::validateForLoopHeader
methods.description: Validates the header of a for-loop, including init, condition, and expression.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::validateForLoopInit
methods.description: Validates the initialization part of a for-loop, ensuring proper type and constant value.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::validateForLoopCond
methods.description: Validates the loop condition, ensuring it compares the loop index with a constant.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::validateForLoopExpr
methods.description: Validates the loop increment/decrement expression, ensuring it modifies the index with a constant.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::isConstExpr
methods.description: Checks if a node is a constant expression.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::isConstIndexExpr
methods.description: Checks if a node is a valid constant index expression.

methods.name: ValidateLimitationsTraverser::validateIndexing
methods.description: Validates index expressions to ensure they are constant unless in vertex shader with uniform.
